set.body: Continuous sampled features with explicit uniform/irregular grids, ZOH widths, run-local centering/sample-SD scaling and masks. Reuse HRF convolution without editing AR/OLS optimization paths. Acceptance: current R numerical fixtures, analytic mass/scaling identities, run isolation and existing HRF/design integration tests. No publication.
set.title: Add run-aware sampled-feature regressors
